description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named HelloController, which provides basic endpoints for the application including welcome, documentation redirect, health check, and app info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A Spring Boot REST Controller providing basic endpoints such as welcome message, API documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/' and returns a welcome message.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/docs' and redirects to Swagger UI, preserving original request scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/health' and returns the application health status.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/api/info' and returns application information.
